items.abstract_or_text: meta: support GLM-5.3 next sm tensor (#30499) * meta: support GLM-5.3 next sm tensor * glm5-next : cont q_absorbed for -sm tensor with non-unified KV * meta : keep GGML_OP_ARANGE in ggml.h order * glm5-next : split MLA heads in pairs for -sm tensor The MLA cache has a single KV head, so the heads on a device are its GQA ratio. The HIP tile FA kernel for D=512 needs an even GQA ratio; with 3 devices the 16 heads of the test model were split 5/5/6 and it aborted. * meta : keep the split for views inside one slab of the split axis With a non-unified KV cache, build_attn_mha splits q into streams with a view. For a permuted q, e.g. the absorbed query of glm5-next, that view aborted with "view of permuted tensor not implemented". The split is now kept if every other dim of the source and the view stays inside one slab of the split axis. The per-device strides are only rescaled above it. From tetherto/qvac-fabric-llm.cpp#353. Co-authored-by: Pratik Narola * glm5-next : drop the q_absorbed cont The meta backend can now split the per-stream view of the permuted q, so the cont is not needed for -sm tensor with a non-unified KV cache. With the cont, the q of flash attention was not contiguous, and when FA ran on the CPU (WebGPU) the meta get_tensor aborted. --------- Co-authored-by: Pratik Narola **Website:** - **Attestations:** - items.abstract_or_text: llama : flash_attn_ext_rows - more efficient unified kv for multi-seq (#29510) * llama : use llm_attn_mask and kv_rows for unified attention Assisted-by: dsh:llama.cpp/ggml-org/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp-GGUF (Mac Studio, M2 Ultra, 192GB) Co-authored-by: Georgi Gerganov * cont : optimize `get_seq_cells` * llama : build the kv_rows lists from per-sequence cell bitmaps Keep a bitmap over the cells for each sequence (the transpose of `seq`), updated in seq_pos_inc/dec, and build the cell lists by walking its set bits. The lists stay in cell order, cells shared by several sequences go to every list, and nothing has to be rebuilt when cells are removed. Also leave out of the lists the cells that the SWA hides from every token of the slice (standard and chunked SWA). * cont : make get_kv_rows_p_min private * cont : minor metal * llama : use kv_rows for every ubatch of a unified cache A ubatch made of equal-length runs with a single sequence each (f.ex. the drafts of several slots) now splits into per-sequence slices. Any other ubatch (interleaved, uneven or coupled sequences) becomes a single slice over the cells of all its sequences instead of falling back to the dense KQ mask, so the graph keeps the topology of the reserved graph. * llama : merge get_kv_rows_seq_ids and get_kv_rows_p_min into get_kv_rows_slices Assisted-by: dsh:llama.cpp/ggml-org/GLM-5.3-Flash-GGUF (Mac Studio, M5 Ultra, 256GB) --------- Co-authored-by: Georgi Gerganov **Website:** - items.title: v0.40.14
items.abstract_or_text: ## What's Changed * `ollama launch claude` now applies the model's output token limit for Claude Code, so cloud models no longer run into the 128k default cap * Cloud web search responses on `/api/chat` are now decoded correctly, including compressed responses * OpenAI-compatible endpoints no longer override a model's packaged sampler defaults — clients that send no `temperature`/`top_p` get the model's own values instead of 1.0, matching `/api/chat` * `/v1/responses` now preserves readable input content, including prior assistant refusals, instead of flattening it * Ollama's app can now retry ChatGPT disconnect failures instead of leaving the connection in a broken state * `ollama launch codex` verifies ChatGPT routing before configuring, and reports a clear error when routing is unavailable * Faster top-k sampling on MLX for large vocabularies **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ollama/ollama/compare/v0.40.13...v0.40.14

items.abstract_or_text: vulkan: fix out-of-bounds NVFP4 UE4M3 scale lookup (#31079) * vulkan : fix out-of-bounds NVFP4 UE4M3 scale lookup On the non-OCP path, ue4m3_fp32_lut has 128 entries and is indexed with the raw scale byte. ggml_validate_row_data accepts every byte and ggml_ue4m3_to_fp32 ignores bit 7, so a byte >= 0x80 reads past the shared array. Vulkan robustness does not cover shared memory. Size the table, both init loops, and the two host shared-memory budgets to 256 entries. ue4m3_to_fp32_build() already masks the exponent and treats only 0 and 0x7F as special, so entries 128-255 match the CPU. A 256-entry table keeps 0xFF distinct from 0x7F: the CPU decodes 0xFF as a non-zero value and 0x7F as zero. Each NVFP4 pipeline uses 512 more bytes of shared memory. ggml_fp32_to_ue4m3 never sets bit 7, so models quantized by llama.cpp are unaffected. items.abstract_or_text: hexagon: tiled hvx permute (#31446) * hexagon: add tiled HVX transpose path for permuted CONT/CPY Permuted copies where dst dim 0 is strided in src, but some other src dim is contiguous, used to fall back to HTP_COPY_KERNEL_RESHAPE. That issues one DMA descriptor per element. The channel-first channel-last permutes around per-channel norms (e.g. [W,H,T,C] [C,W,H,T] in video VAEs) ht this path, and these copies ran at about 45 MB/s. Add HTP_COPY_KERNEL_TRANSPOSE for same-type, same-shape f32/f16 copies into a contiguous dst. Host: - drop extent-1 dims and merge dims that stay adjacent in src into a canonical view, stored in the kernel params. There are no minimum size limits. - the copy is treated as a 2D transpose between dst dim 0 and the contiguous src dim, batched over the remaining dims. - tiles are sized to 64 KB per buffer and halved until they fit in session VTCM. blkk is capped so the halfword vgather offsets fit in 16 bits. Kernel, per tile: - 2D DMA of blk0 strided src rows (blkk contiguous elements each) into VTCM - vgather transpose in 32x32 (f32) or 64x64 (f16) blocks - 2D DMA of blkk contiguous rows out to dst Staged and transposed buffers are double-buffered, so the next tile's input DMA overlaps the current transpose and output DMA. Tiles are split across threads and mdev sessions. Small dims: - packed mode: when dim k follows dim 0 and dim 0 divides the HVX lanes (f32: 2/4/8/16, f16: 2/4/.../32), one vgather writes several whole dst rows, and each tile goes out as one contiguous DMA. - when the contiguous src dim fits in one vector, it is staged exactly and the tile is made long along dim 0. All other copies select the same kernels as before. Tests: add test_cont cases for perms {1,2,3,0} and {3,0,1,2}, f32 and f16, at various sizes. * hexagon: cpy transpose cleanups - fix vgather halfword offset comments: offsets are unsigned 16-bit, caps are kept lower for speed - set packed directly in the packed case - add dim_k == 3 CONT tests (full reversal) Assisted-by: Claude Opus 5.5 * hexagon: use cpy transpose path for ne[0] == 1 permutes - drop the nb[0] check in the transpose solver: size-1 dims are skipped, and the canonical tp.nb[0] check covers packed dim 0 - try the transpose path before SAMESHAPE_SAMETYPE, which did one DMA per element for these - add ne[0] == 1 permute CPY tests Assisted-by: Claude Opus 5.5 * hex-cpy: further improve cpy Bring in improvements from aizip branch/PR. Cleanup kparams and replace divs with fastdiv. Co-authored-by: Yiwei Shao * hex-cpy: avoid vtcm bank conflicts * hex-cpy: trim down the comments * cpy-test: trim down new tests that cover permute scenarios --------- Co-authored-by: Max Krasnyansky Co-authored-by: Yiwei Shao **Website:** - items.abstract_or_text: mtmd: Pocket tts - support for voices without voice cloning (#31429) * feat: support PocketTTS voices with no voice cloning The kyutai/pocket-tts-without-voice-cloning weights ship predefined voices as the backbone KV state after the voice prompt.
